dialogues.en:
I give a big yawn in my warm blanket and look at the
ceiling. Since I didn't have a dream last night, I had a
good sleep.
dialogues.text:
I give a big yawn in my warm blanket and look at the
ceiling. Since I didn't have a dream last night, I had a
good sleep.

dialogues.jp: ピッ。
dialogues.en:
My body is completely relaxed, but today I kind of wanted to
have the dream.
dialogues.text:
My body is completely relaxed, but today I kind of wanted to
have the dream.

dialogues.en:
That dream. I wanted to have that dream again and confirm
things.
dialogues.text:
That dream. I wanted to have that dream again and confirm
things.

dialogues.jp: 「ふわあ……。ふう……」
dialogues.en: "A cat...... Cat ears...... Yoriko......"
dialogues.text: "A cat...... Cat ears...... Yoriko......"

dialogues.jp:
思い切りあくびをし、ぬくぬくとした布団の中
で天井を見つめる。昨日は夢を見なかったせい
か、快眠だった。
dialogues.en:
Even a three year-old knows whether it's normal to have cat
ears or not.
dialogues.text:
Even a three year-old knows whether it's normal to have cat
ears or not.

dialogues.en:
But when I put together the three things --a cat, cat ears,
and Yoriko-- it makes me imagine a very complicated and
weird situation.
dialogues.text:
But when I put together the three things --a cat, cat ears,
and Yoriko-- it makes me imagine a very complicated and
weird situation.

dialogues.jp:
身体をだらんと弛緩させ、けれど今日は、夢を
見なかった事が少し惜しい。
dialogues.en: "But it can't be......"
dialogues.text: "But it can't be......"

dialogues.jp:
例の夢。あれをもう一度見て、確かめたかった
のに。
dialogues.en: I get out of bed and stretch.
dialogues.text: I get out of bed and stretch.

dialogues.jp: 「猫……ネコ耳……頼子……」
dialogues.en:
As I'm stretching, I think about a sweet dessert that's on
my mind for no reason.
dialogues.text:
As I'm stretching, I think about a sweet dessert that's on
my mind for no reason.

dialogues.jp:
３歳児でも知っている──ネコ耳は微妙か──
単語の｛られつ／羅列｝。何の変哲もなく。
dialogues.en:
I clasp my hand and opened it. The next moment, I have a
steamed bean-jam bun on my hand.
dialogues.text:
I clasp my hand and opened it. The next moment, I have a
steamed bean-jam bun on my hand.

dialogues.jp:
しかしピースを組み合わせると、とんでもなく
奇妙な──かったるい図が浮かび上がりそうだ。
dialogues.en: "......I do have a weird supernatural power."
dialogues.text: "......I do have a weird supernatural power."

dialogues.jp: 「でも、まさか……なあ」
dialogues.en:
As long as I have this power, I can not deny a possibility
of......
dialogues.text:
As long as I have this power, I can not deny a possibility
of......

dialogues.jp:
ベッドから起きあがり、ぬるい空気の中、大き
く伸びをする。
dialogues.en: A possibility of a cat transforming to a human.
dialogues.text: A possibility of a cat transforming to a human.

dialogues.jp:
そうしながらも、頭の中に適当な和菓子を思い
浮かべていた。
dialogues.en: "It sounds like the story of The Grateful Crane."
dialogues.text: "It sounds like the story of The Grateful Crane."

dialogues.jp:
手の平を握りしめ、開く。次の瞬間、そこにま
んじゅうが乗っていた。
dialogues.en: But I don't remember doing anything so kind to a cat.
dialogues.text: But I don't remember doing anything so kind to a cat.

dialogues.jp: 「……やっぱ、ヘンな能力だよなあ……」
dialogues.en: "Good morning."
dialogues.text: "Good morning."

dialogues.jp:
これがある限り、あながち否定は出来ない。つ
まり──。
dialogues.en:
I say good morning for the first time in a few months, and
enter the living room. Yoriko-san is still sleeping on the
sofa.
dialogues.text:
I say good morning for the first time in a few months, and
enter the living room. Yoriko-san is still sleeping on the
sofa.

dialogues.jp: 猫が人間に｛へんげ／変化｝するって事を。
dialogues.en:
Her ears twitch, as if they were reacting to my voice or
sensing something.
dialogues.text:
Her ears twitch, as if they were reacting to my voice or
sensing something.

dialogues.jp: 「鶴の恩返しかよ」
そして俺には、恩を売った覚えがないのだった。
dialogues.en:
I walk towards her slowly and quietly. I stand near her and
look at her sleeping face.
dialogues.text:
I walk towards her slowly and quietly. I stand near her and
look at her sleeping face.

dialogues.jp: 「おはよー」
dialogues.en:
She's a different type of beautiful girl that I haven't met
before.
dialogues.text:
She's a different type of beautiful girl that I haven't met
before.

dialogues.jp:
久々に朝の挨拶を口にしながら居間に入ると、
頼子さんはソファーでまだ眠っていた。
dialogues.en: Every part of her face is perfect and well-balanced.
dialogues.text: Every part of her face is perfect and well-balanced.

dialogues.jp: 声や気配に反応したのか、耳がぴくぴくと動く。
dialogues.en:
And she has the cat ears as an accent, like a stone thrown
into a quiet water surface.
dialogues.text:
And she has the cat ears as an accent, like a stone thrown
into a quiet water surface.

dialogues.en: I reach my hand towards her ear.
dialogues.text: I reach my hand towards her ear.

dialogues.jp:
足音を忍ばせ近づいていく。頼子さんの傍らに
立ち、その寝顔を見下ろした。

何というか、今まで俺の周りに居なかったタイ
プの美人だ。
dialogues.en: Twitch!
dialogues.text: Twitch!

dialogues.jp:
ひどく整った顔立ちをしている。一つ一つの造
作のバランスが、なかなかに完璧なのだ。
dialogues.en:
I touched it softly, but her cat ears reacted as if they
were struck.
dialogues.text:
I touched it softly, but her cat ears reacted as if they
were struck.

dialogues.jp:
そして、静かな水面に波紋を投げかけるような、
ネコ耳のアクセント。
dialogues.en:
It's funny to watch, and also feels good. So I can't stop
doing it over and over again.
dialogues.text:
It's funny to watch, and also feels good. So I can't stop
doing it over and over again.

dialogues.jp: 俺は、そっと手を伸ばした。
dialogues.en: Twitch. Twitch.
dialogues.text: Twitch. Twitch.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.en: "Umm... ah... ummmm......"
dialogues.text: "Umm... ah... ummmm......"

dialogues.jp: ぴくん。
dialogues.en: Touch... Twitch! Touch... Twitch!
dialogues.text: Touch... Twitch! Touch... Twitch!

dialogues.jp:
ただ触れただけなのに、弾かれでもしたような
反応を見せるネコ耳。
dialogues.en: "Ummm... mmmm......"
dialogues.text: "Ummm... mmmm......"

dialogues.jp:
それが面白くて、何となく気持ちよくて、つい
つい何度も繰り返してしまう。
dialogues.en: Touch... Twitch! Touch... Twitch!
dialogues.text: Touch... Twitch! Touch... Twitch!

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「ん、あ、んん……」
こちょ。ぴくん。こちょ。ぴくん。

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.en:
My hand and face freeze. I try to break my paralyzed face
and give a fake smile.
dialogues.text:
My hand and face freeze. I try to break my paralyzed face
and give a fake smile.

dialogues.jp: こちょ。ぴくん。こちょ。ぴくん。………。
dialogues.en:
"Oh, ha-ha-ha...... I was just... trying to get rid of some
dust from your face."
dialogues.text:
"Oh, ha-ha-ha...... I was just... trying to get rid of some
dust from your face."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.en: "Ummm... mmm...... Good morning......"
dialogues.text: "Ummm... mmm...... Good morning......"

dialogues.jp:
手が固まる。ついでに顔も。石化した顔面を無
理矢理崩し、笑みを浮かべる。

「あ、あっはっは……。その……ゴミが付いて
　いてね」
dialogues.en:
She's a maid who can't wake up in the morning. Well, but it
actually saved me from being called a molester.
dialogues.text:
She's a maid who can't wake up in the morning. Well, but it
actually saved me from being called a molester.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「ん、んん……おはようございまふ……」
dialogues.en:
I stretch my back that was bent down for a while, and I
start to prepare breakfast.
dialogues.text:
I stretch my back that was bent down for a while, and I
start to prepare breakfast.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「ん……すう、すう……」
dialogues.en: "I, I'm sorry......"
dialogues.text: "I, I'm sorry......"

dialogues.jp:
何とも寝起きの悪いメイドさんである。まぁ、
今回はそれが幸いしたわけだが……。
dialogues.en: "Oh, it's okay."
dialogues.text: "Oh, it's okay."

dialogues.jp:
前にかがんで少し凝った腰を伸ばすと、俺は朝
食の用意に取りかかったのだった。
dialogues.en:
Facing a regular boring breakfast with toast, scrambled eggs
and coffee, Yoriko-san looks very embarrassed.
dialogues.text:
Facing a regular boring breakfast with toast, scrambled eggs
and coffee, Yoriko-san looks very embarrassed.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「す、すみませんでした……」
dialogues.en: "But...... I'm your maid and I overslept......"
dialogues.text: "But...... I'm your maid and I overslept......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「いや、まあいいって」
dialogues.en: "And you prepared breakfast, too......"
dialogues.text: "And you prepared breakfast, too......"

dialogues.jp:
トーストにコーヒー、スクランブルエッグとい
う何の面白みもない朝食の向こう側で、頼子さ
んはしきりに恐縮していた。
dialogues.en: "It's all right. Let's eat."
dialogues.text: "It's all right. Let's eat."

dialogues.jp:
そう言って、お手本でも示すように、バターたっ
ぷりのトーストに手を伸ばす。
dialogues.en:
As if trying to show her how to eat, I reach my hand to a
piece of toast.
dialogues.text:
As if trying to show her how to eat, I reach my hand to a
piece of toast.

dialogues.jp:
それでもまだ固まったままの頼子さんに、俺は
もう一度促した。
dialogues.en: But she's still stiff, so I urge her again.
dialogues.text: But she's still stiff, so I urge her again.

dialogues.jp:
「ほら、もうそんなに気にしないで。俺は別に
　何とも思ってないし」
dialogues.en: "Hey, don't worry about it. I don't mind at all."
dialogues.text: "Hey, don't worry about it. I don't mind at all."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あ、は、はい……すいませんでした……」
dialogues.en: "Ah, o-okay...... Thank you so much......"
dialogues.text: "Ah, o-okay...... Thank you so much......"

dialogues.jp:
それでようやく気が済んだのか、頼子さんはトー
ストに手を伸ばした。
dialogues.en:
It looks like she finally let go of her guilt. And she
reaches out her hand to a piece of toast.
dialogues.text:
It looks like she finally let go of her guilt. And she
reaches out her hand to a piece of toast.

dialogues.jp:
俺もホッとした気分になり、口の中のバターの
味が分かるようになる。
dialogues.en:
The tension's gone now and I can finally taste the butter on
the toast in my mouth.
dialogues.text:
The tension's gone now and I can finally taste the butter on
the toast in my mouth.

dialogues.jp:
重苦しい気分で食べるパンなんて、粘土みたい
なものだからな。
dialogues.en:
Bread can taste like clay when you have to eat in a heavy
atmosphere.
dialogues.text:
Bread can taste like clay when you have to eat in a heavy
atmosphere.

dialogues.jp:
コーヒーカップに口をつけた頼子さんが、眉を
ひそめた。
dialogues.en: She frowns when she puts her mouth to the coffee cup.
dialogues.text: She frowns when she puts her mouth to the coffee cup.

dialogues.jp: 「ん？　どうかした？」
dialogues.en: "What? What's the matter?"
dialogues.text: "What? What's the matter?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あ、い、いえ、その……何でもないんです」
dialogues.en: "Ah, n-no... I mean nothing......"
dialogues.text: "Ah, n-no... I mean nothing......"

dialogues.jp:
一瞬だけ浮かべた不審そうな顔は、すぐに取り
つくろうような笑みに取って代わられた。
dialogues.en:
The frown that she gave for a moment quickly changes to a
fake smile.
dialogues.text:
The frown that she gave for a moment quickly changes to a
fake smile.

dialogues.jp:
「……そう？　あ、もしや、コーヒーって苦手
　だった？　紅茶とかの方がいい？」
dialogues.en:
"...... Are you sure? Oh, you don't like coffee? Did you
like tea better?"
dialogues.text:
"...... Are you sure? Oh, you don't like coffee? Did you
like tea better?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「い、いえ、そんな事はないんです」
dialogues.en: "N-No, it's not that."
dialogues.text: "N-No, it's not that."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「明日から用意しようか？」
dialogues.en: "I can make you tea from tomorrow."
dialogues.text: "I can make you tea from tomorrow."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あ、ほんとに気になさらないで下さい……」
dialogues.en: "Ah, please don't mind me......"
dialogues.text: "Ah, please don't mind me......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「そう……ならいいけど」
dialogues.en: "Okay...... if you say so."
dialogues.text: "Okay...... if you say so."

dialogues.jp:
会話が途切れ、無言のままトーストを胃に収め
ていく。
dialogues.en:
It's the end of the conversation, and we just keep eating
toast without a word.
dialogues.text:
It's the end of the conversation, and we just keep eating
toast without a word.

dialogues.jp:
相手が音夢なら馬鹿話の一つも出てくるところ
だけど、頼子さんが相手ではそうもいかない。
dialogues.en:
If it was Nemu, I'd have a silly conversation making fun of
her or something, but I can't do that with Yoriko-san.
dialogues.text:
If it was Nemu, I'd have a silly conversation making fun of
her or something, but I can't do that with Yoriko-san.

dialogues.jp:
スプーンが皿に当たる音と、コーヒーがずずと
飲まれる音──どちらも俺だけ出している──
だけが部屋を飛び交った。
dialogues.en:
The sound of a spoon hitting a plate and a cup of coffee
being sipped, which are the noises that only I'm making,
echo in the room.
dialogues.text:
The sound of a spoon hitting a plate and a cup of coffee
being sipped, which are the noises that only I'm making,
echo in the room.

dialogues.jp: ふむ。
dialogues.en: Hum.
dialogues.text: Hum.

dialogues.jp: 何か場の和むギャグはないかなっと。
dialogues.en:
What kind of joke can I tell her to make the tension go
away?
dialogues.text:
What kind of joke can I tell her to make the tension go
away?

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あ、あの……聞きたい事があるんですが……」
dialogues.en: "Ah, umm...... I want to ask you something......"
dialogues.text: "Ah, umm...... I want to ask you something......"

dialogues.jp: カップを置き、頼子さんがおずおず切り出す。
dialogues.en: She puts her cup down and starts talking.
dialogues.text: She puts her cup down and starts talking.

dialogues.en: "What is it?"
dialogues.text: "What is it?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「お恥ずかしい事とは承知でお尋ねしますが、
　その……メイドのお仕事って、どういうのが
　あるのでしょうか……？」
dialogues.en:
I answer animatedly. I really don't like having breakfast in
silence.
dialogues.text:
I answer animatedly. I really don't like having breakfast in
silence.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.en: "Ah, I wasn't going to ask you those......"
dialogues.text: "Ah, I wasn't going to ask you those......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「あ、ご、ごめんなさい、その……変な事を｛き／訊｝
　いてしまって……」
dialogues.en:
"I know it's very embarrassing to ask you this...... but
what kind of work does a maid usually do?"
dialogues.text:
"I know it's very embarrassing to ask you this...... but
what kind of work does a maid usually do?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「いやいや、別にいいんだよ、うん」
dialogues.en:
"Ah, I-I'm very sorry. I did ask you a stupid question,
didn't I?"
dialogues.text:
"Ah, I-I'm very sorry. I did ask you a stupid question,
didn't I?"

dialogues.jp: まあ、元が猫だしなあ……。
dialogues.en: "No, no. It's okay, really."
dialogues.text: "No, no. It's okay, really."

dialogues.jp:
そんな訳で、俺は、メイドさんのお仕事を、メ
モ帳にリストアップしてあげたのだった。
dialogues.en: Well, I can't blame her, because she used to be a cat......
dialogues.text: Well, I can't blame her, because she used to be a cat......

dialogues.jp: ◆メイドのお仕事◆

昨日の夢の続きが見られるかもしれないと思っ
ていたのだが、生憎、今日は夢を見ることはな
かった。

朝食を食べていると、神妙な顔をした頼子さん
からメイドの仕事とは何をすれがいいのかとい
う質問された。
まぁ、元が猫なら仕方ない。
dialogues.en: Beep.
dialogues.text: Beep.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、メイドの仕事をリストアップしてあげた
のだった。
